skills.name: 怀远
skills.exactText: 你的初始手牌称为“绥”。当你失去一张“绥”后，你为一名角色选择一项：1.手牌上限+1；2.攻击范围+1；3.摸一张牌。当你死亡时，你可以令一名其他角色获得你以此法增加的手牌上限和攻击范围。
skills.rawOrdinaryText:
你的初始手牌称为“绥”。当你失去一张“绥”后，你为一名角色选择一项：

当你死亡时，你可以令一名其他角色获得你以此法增加的手牌上限和攻击范围。

boundaryAssessment.officialBasis: Huaiyuan identifies initial hand cards as Sui; current characteristic describes using/clearing initial hand cards. Neither specifies removal of the identity mark or a re-entry rule.
boundaryAssessment.confidence: Initial hand entity origin is explicit; identity lifetime is unresolved.
unresolved: Whether first loss clears the Sui mark permanently or the original entity remains Sui after return.
Whether owner hand to own equipment counts as loss for this skill, and whether a Sui in own equipment prevents Dezhang.
Whether a stolen original Sui triggers again after reacquisition and another qualifying loss.

candidateMappings: Immutable initial entity set plus explicit owner possession/loss predicate; original identity can survive a return.
Consumed per-original-card Sui identity at first qualifying loss; later return is ordinary.
boundaryAssessment.caution: A historical official Buzhi guide says own equipment returned to own hand is gain but not loss. This is a generic analogy, not a ruling for the opposite move or Huaiyuan. No hand-exit shortcut may be labelled official.
boundaryAssessment.round18EngineDecision: At genuine GameStarting initialize exact InitialDeal owner-Hand entities once. First actual movement from that own Hand consumes each original mark, including ownHand to ownEquipment. Return/reacquisition does not restore a consumed mark and its later loss cannot reward again. This is a deliberate engine mapping, not a verified FAQ.

boundaryAssessment.confidence: Per-entity interpretation is a strong textual inference; exact batch/candidate sequencing is not a quoted FAQ.
boundaryAssessment.proposedMapping: One issued choice per qualifying original Sui entity in the real movement batch, with immutable event/source/card identity; a paid/native child cannot duplicate or erase a later owed choice.

boundaryAssessment.round18EngineDecision: One mandatory exact loss-benefit candidate per distinct consumed original entity, including multiple entities in one actual batch; repeated benefit options are allowed. A typed child resumes each invoice exactly once.

boundaryAssessment.officialBasis: The death clause says a different character obtains the hand limit and attack range you increased by this method.
unresolved: Whether the inherited quantity is the deceased owner own received increments or all increments that owner granted to any recipient.

boundaryAssessment.implementationNeed: Track each actual recipient, granting source owner and modifier kind so later decision does not require conflating totals; do not silently remove other recipients modifiers.
boundaryAssessment.round18EngineDecision: At optional native OwnerDied invocation, freeze only the dying owner currently received hand-limit and attack-range increments belonging to this original-hand bonus family. Move those own increments to one other living recipient; do not aggregate all awards the dead owner gave other recipients, and keep those recipients existing awards unchanged. Origin provenance distinguishes other mechanisms. This is an explicit engine choice without a targeted official FAQ.

boundaryAssessment.officialBasis: Once in Play phase, owner and another character with hand each recast one card. Client owner prompt requests a recast card and an other-with-hand target; partner prompt requests one recast card.
boundaryAssessment.confirmed: Other target has hand cards at selection; owner selects a material and target; no client tooltip gives ordering or a region ruling.
unresolved: Whether owner or partner finishes recast first or the pair is simultaneous.
Whether equipment is an eligible recast material.
Whether partner material is chosen before owner discard/draw children or afterward.

boundaryAssessment.r17AgreedGenericContract: Selected owner one Hand card plus OtherLivingWithHand target, then partner privately chooses one Hand card. Freeze both materials before payment. Ordered owner recast movement and Draw1, then partner recast movement and Draw1. Later-invalid material is not replaced; completed payment and owed Draw/return survive child pauses and source loss exactly once.
boundaryAssessment.officialFaqStatus: No Chongxin-specific order/zone FAQ found in bounded search.
boundaryAssessment.round18EngineDecision: R17 accepted generic PairedHandRecast: exact one owner Hand material plus OtherLivingWithHand, private forced one partner Hand material; freeze both before payment; owner complete recast movement and Draw1 children before partner does likewise. Later-invalid unpaid material is skipped without substitution; completed payment and draw obligation survive source loss. Hand-only and ordering are engine mappings, not verified character-specific FAQ.

boundaryAssessment.proposedMapping: A positive native Draw batch yields one owed choice; direct draws produced by this exact Weishu effect are excluded, while unrelated CardsGained and zero-actual-card draw attempts are not treated as draws. Freeze direct producer identity and actual phase. Blanket ancestor-chain exclusion requires a separate explicit decision.

boundaryAssessment.round18EngineDecision: One mandatory trigger per completed native DrawCards invocation with positive actual count, attached to its final native draw batch. Exclude any actual global Draw phase and direct draws whose stable owner+skill producer is this Weishu. InitialDeal, gifts/other gains, flipped/obtained cards and actual-zero draw attempts do not count. This batch interpretation is an engine mapping, not a verified FAQ.

boundaryAssessment.proposedMapping: Observe committed owner-card discard-to-DiscardPile movement with real Discard reason, not recast/use/give/transfer. boundaryAssessment.round18EngineDecision: One mandatory trigger per actual native batch of this owner HEJ cards entering DiscardPile for true Discard, outside the actual global Discard phase. Use native discard classification, never recast/use/death/transfer merely ending in discard. Owner must select one other living discardable HEJ entity, using native opaque Hand slot and equipment child rules; no legal target means no effect. Batch/global-phase interpretation is explicit engine mapping.
